title: Candidate Intake Wizard
description: A step‑by‑step flow that guides users through registering a new candidate, capturing their work preferences, and defining their availability.

endpoints.title: Create Candidate
endpoints.description: Register a new candidate and collect their basic personal and employment information.

fields.name: currentLocation
fields.label: Current Location
fields.description: The city and country where the candidate lives.

fields.name: employmentStatus
fields.label: Employment Status
fields.description: Whether the candidate is currently employed.

endpoints.title: Create Work Preferences
endpoints.description: Capture the candidate’s preferred role, work arrangement, and salary expectations.

fields.name: desiredRole
fields.label: Desired Role
fields.description: The job title or role the candidate is seeking.

fields.name: workArrangement
fields.label: Work Arrangement
fields.description: Preferred mode of work (remote, hybrid, or onsite).

fields.name: salaryExpectationMin
fields.label: Salary Expectation Minimum
fields.description: Minimum acceptable annual salary in US dollars.

fields.name: salaryExpectationMax
fields.label: Salary Expectation Maximum
fields.description: Maximum acceptable annual salary in US dollars.

endpoints.title: Create Availability
endpoints.description: Define when the candidate can start and any notice period for leaving their current job.

fields.name: earliestStartDate
fields.label: Earliest Start Date
fields.description: The earliest date the candidate could begin work.

fields.name: noticePeriodDays
fields.label: Notice Period Days
fields.description: Number of days the candidate must give notice before resigning.

fields.name: reasonForLeaving
fields.label: Reason For Leaving
fields.description: Explanation of why the candidate is leaving their current role (optional).
